basis: Scenario labels only. Each drop's README and provenance.json state what the capture was for; 'pathology' marks the four traces whose own description is a thrashing pattern (repeated re-reads), 'benign' marks every other trace. These are NOT adjudicated safety labels: no trace in corpus/m1-m8 contains sabotage, deception or sandbagging, and none is scored as such.
